name: Volcanic & aviation ash
value: Mayon ash; no red codes on major routes
summary: Mayon spews ash and evacuations grow; no red aviation codes on major air routes
state: Mayon in the Philippines produced repeated ash plumes in early November, with nearly 4,000 people evacuated by 3 Nov (Anadolu; Daily Tribune), and VAAC advisories were issued for Mayon and Lewotolo. No volcano near major international air routes was at colour code red and no large explosive eruption was reported as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Travellers to the Bicol region should follow PHIVOLCS and local advice.
rubric_hit: No red codes on major routes, no large eruption = Normal

why: Major eruptions ground flights (Iceland 2010) and can cool the climate for years.
drivers: Volcanic unrest; impact depends on ash plume height and jet-stream direction.

rubric.alert: Major airspace closures from ash, or a VEI 4+ eruption.
rubric.watch: Aviation colour code orange/red at a volcano near major air routes, or a large eruption.
rubric.normal: No aviation colour code red; no large eruptions.
